park4night-revanced.description: Park4night Morphe builds upon the original Park4night app by AppMobilEdition, a community-driven tool for discovering and sharing spots to relax, overnight, picnic, or camp with user reviews, photos, and filters. This modification applies the 'Unlock Pro features' patch from the brosssh/revanced-patches repository to the package fr.tramb.park4night, bypassing the €9.99/year subscription for premium access without specific version requirements.
